## Task
An anonymous black-box function of 8 continuous inputs in [0, 1]; lower is better.

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_c6f` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_d31` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_c38` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_3d4` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_78c` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_0eb` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_b3a` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_bc0` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `y`: objective; minimize (lower is better).

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.
